title: Patient Payment Plan Signing Balance: Disputed Accounts and Reductions
content:
The signing balance on which a **Patient Payment Plan** down payment is taken follows what has happened to the enrolled accounts. Billing holds are read from the patient's hospital accounts in the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing); enrollments and reductions from the offer itself.

**Rule.** When the first of the patient's accounts listed on a charge-dispute billing hold is an account enrolled on the offer, the signing balance is the enrolled total less the amount enrolled for that account; when that does not apply and reductions have been booked on the offer, it is the offer's ledger balance, the amounts enrolled less the reductions booked; otherwise it is the enrolled total.

| First account listed on a charge-dispute hold is enrolled on the offer | Reductions booked on the offer | Signing balance |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | enrolled total less that account's enrolled amount |
| No (or no account on such a hold) | Yes | amounts enrolled less reductions booked |
| No (or no account on such a hold) | No | enrolled total |

**Hypothetical.** Enrolled 2200.00 and 1800.00 (total 4000.00), with a 300.00 reduction booked: if the 1800.00 account is the first listed on a charge-dispute hold the signing balance is 2200.00; if no enrolled account is on such a hold it is 3700.00.
